focus_area: AiJobCriteria model + Job criteria methods (extract_job_criteria_immediately, extract_job_criteria_if_needed, latest_ai_job_criteria, latest_succeeded_ai_job_criteria, zero_criteria_extraction_failure?) vs AiJobApplicationSummary/AiJobApplicationSummaryStatus analog

findings.title: extract_job_criteria_immediately re-queries latest_ai_job_criteria on each guard line instead of memoizing like its sibling methods
findings.description: extract_job_criteria_immediately calls latest_ai_job_criteria (a fresh `ai_job_criteria.order(created_at: :desc).first` query) twice — once at line 732 (status_in_progress?) and again at line 733 (status_retrying?). When reached via extract_job_criteria_if_needed (job.rb:744 also calls latest_ai_job_criteria), that is three identical queries for one logical 'what is the latest row' question. The two sibling methods auto_extract_job_criteria (job.rb:703) and extract_job_criteria (job.rb:720) both memoize `existing_ai_job_criteria = latest_ai_job_criteria` into a local and reuse it, so _immediately is inconsistent with the established pattern in the same file. No correctness impact (no write occurs between the reads, so both return the same row; these are not hot paths). Purely a minor repeated-query / consistency observation.
findings.recommendation: Optionally memoize `existing = latest_ai_job_criteria` once and reuse for the in_progress/retrying guards, matching auto_extract_job_criteria/extract_job_criteria. Non-blocking.
